function.description: Primary focus is on sharing information across organizational boundaries. A number of authors make a distinction between information sharing and knowledge exchange.

network_type: Knowledge generation and exchange, knowledge management

function.description: Primary focus is the generation of new knowledge, as well as the spread of new ideas and practices between organizations.
Primary focus is on building social capital in community settings, and on improving the administrative capacity of the network members.

network_type: Individual, organizational, network and community learning

function.description: Primary focus here is learning, which overlaps both with knowledge exchange and capacity building. Knight and Pye (2005) describe network level learning.
Primary focus is on improving response to complex issues, and/or solving complex problems (where a solution is possible). Often emerges from an information diffusion or knowledge exchange network.

network_type: Effective service delivery, service implementation, service coordination, action

function.description: Primary focus is service delivery, where services are jointly produced by more than two organizations. Collaboration is often between programs in larger organizations.
Primary focus is on creating an environment where diversity, collaboration and openness are promoted with the goal of enabling and diffusing innovation.
Primary focus here is an interest in public decisions within a particular area of policy. The original conceptualization of policy networks concerned decision making about public resource allocation.
Primary focus on direction, control and coordination of collective action between government agencies and non-public groups, including government funded initiatives or contracts.
